Shipping - Standard shipping
Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days and costs $4.99. Orders with a subtotal of $75 or more ship free with standard shipping.
</document>

<document source="data/kb/shipping.md">
Shipping - Express shipping
Express shipping takes 2 business days and costs $14.99. Express shipping is never free, including on orders that qualify for free standard shipping.
</document>

<document source="data/kb/refunds.md">
Returns and Refunds - Return shipping
A prepaid return label costs $6.95, and the amount is deducted from your refund. If the item arrived defective or damaged, the return label is free.
</document>
